paragraphs.text: Not condemning him as accused whom God visits, knowing that there are various reasons why God lays his hand on us, yea and afterwards he restores us.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: When for sorrow and grief of mind he calls himself on his bed.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: You have restored him in his sick bed and sent him comfort.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: That is, curse me and cannot have their cruel hate quenched but with my shameful death.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: For pretending to comfort me, he conspires my death in his heart, and brags of it.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: The enemies thought by his sharp punishments that God had become his mortal enemy.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: As David felt this falsehood, and as it was chiefly accomplished in Christ, Joh 13:18 so shall his members continually prove the same.
paragraphs.label: g
paragraphs.anchor: hath lifted up his heel against

paragraphs.text: Meaning, either in prosperity of life or in the true fear of God against all temptation.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: Showing me evident signs of your fatherly providence.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: By this repetition he stirs up the faithful to praise God.
paragraphs.label: k
